concerns.text: T014 claims to satisfy FR-001 but only describes 'fetching' and 'filtering'. FR-001 explicitly mandates normalizing kinetic data using Arrhenius/Eyring equations and implementing specific fallback logic for missing Ea (class average calculation or exclusion). The task description omits the normalization logic entirely, creating a semantic gap where the deliverable cannot satisfy the FR.

T016 is marked as incomplete/missing (checkbox unchecked). FR-002 mandates the construction of heterogeneous molecular graphs with specific node/edge features. Without this task being defined and actionable, the core data structure required for FR-003 (GNN) and FR-005 (SHAP) is absent, violating the requirement that all FRs be covered by tasks.

T023 is marked as incomplete/missing. FR-003 requires a heterophily-aware GNN (GAT/GraphSAGE) as the primary method. The absence of a concrete task to implement this architecture means the project cannot satisfy the core modeling requirement defined in the spec.

T031 (SHAP) and T033 (correlation) are marked as incomplete/missing. FR-005 and SC-003 require SHAP analysis and statistical correlation against an independent descriptor vector. The lack of tasks to implement these steps means the interpretability success criteria cannot be met.

T011a (memory_monitor.py) is marked as missing. FR-008 requires the system to enforce memory limits and trigger a graceful exit or sampling. T011b (sampling) depends on T011a to detect the limit breach. Without T011a, the memory enforcement mechanism is incomplete, violating FR-008.

T018a and T018b are marked as missing. FR-007 mandates logging all data exclusions to an audit file. The tasks responsible for implementing this logging in the ingestion and preprocessing flows are absent, meaning the reproducibility requirement for audit trails cannot be satisfied.

T026 is marked as incomplete. FR-006 requires a stratified permutation test to account for scaffold-induced correlation. The absence of this task means the statistical significance validation (SC-002) has no implementation path.

T001 (project structure) and T003 (linting) are marked as missing. Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) requires a runnable project structure with pinned dependencies and standard tooling. The absence of these foundational tasks violates the constitutional requirement for reproducibility.
